data.title: Nvidia's share slide knocks it below Alphabet in valuation
data.description:
Nov 20 (Reuters) - Nvidia ( NVDA ), the centerpiece of Wall Street's AI trade, slipped behind Google parent Alphabet to become the fourth-most valuable US company on Friday, as a prolonged selloff in the chipmaker's shares reshuffled the top of the market-value rankings.

The stock, last down 3% and valued at $3.4 trillion, was on course for a seventh straight weekly decline, its longest losing streak since 2008.

The slide comes days after Nvidia's ( NVDA ) first earnings report since co-founder Jensen Huang's resignation, which failed to ease investor concerns about leadership and the durability of AI spending.

Nvidia's ( NVDA ) fall down the market-value rankings also underscores a shift within the AI trade, as investors gravitate toward companies that pair heavy AI investment with established cloud and software revenue streams.

Apple ( AAPL ), seen as less exposed to the AI trade, remained well ahead with a market value of $5.08 trillion. Microsoft ( MSFT ) ranked second at $3.72 trillion, followed by Alphabet at $3.44 trillion, according to LSEG data.

(Reporting by Medha Singh in Bengaluru; Editing by Joyjeet Das)

data.title: Johnson & Johnson Says Phase 4 Trial of Tremfya in Psoriatic Arthritis Meets Endpoints
data.description:
10:27 AM EST, 11/20/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Johnson & Johnson ( JNJ ) said Friday that a phase 4 trial of Tremfya in adults with active psoriatic arthritis and axial involvement met the primary and major secondary endpoints.

Tremfya showed significant improvement in axial symptoms compared with placebo, and significant reduction of inflammation in the sacroiliac joints, as assessed through magnetic resonance imaging, the company said.

Johnson & Johnson ( JNJ ) said axial involvement may affect about 5% to 28% of people with early psoriatic arthritis and 25% to 70% percent of those with longer-standing disease. Inflammation of the spine and sacroiliac joints may lead to back pain and stiffness, the company said.

Johnson & Johnson ( JNJ ) shares were up 1.9% in Friday trading.

data.title: US Dollar Falls Early Friday Ahead of Waller, Michigan, State Unemployment
data.description:
07:41 AM EST, 11/20/2026 (MT Newswires) -- The US dollar fell against its major trading partners early Friday, except for an increase versus the euro, ahead of another appearance by Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller at 8:25 am ET.

Waller made headlines on Wednesday by calling for "aggressive action" on interest rates that would "shock" businesses and markets.

The final University of Michigan consumer sentiment reading for November and state-level unemployment data for October are both due to be released at 10:00 am ET.

The Kansas City Fed's services reading for November is scheduled to be released at 11:00 am ET and the St. Louis Fed is expected to update its GDP nowcast estimate for Q4 around midday, followed by an appearance by Fed Governor Lisa Cook at 12:15 pm ET.

A quick summary of foreign exchange activity heading into Friday:

EUR/USD fell to 1.0963 from 1.0972 at the Thursday US close and 1.0986 at the same time Thursday morning. Eurozone consumer confidence data for November are due to be released at 10:00 am ET. The next European Central Bank meeting is scheduled for Dec. 17.

GBP/USD rose to 1.3103 from 1.3095 at the Thursday US close but was below a reading of 1.3157 at the same time Thursday morning. UK retail sales rebounded in October, lifting the year-over-year rates, according to data released earlier Friday. The next Bank of England meeting is scheduled for Dec. 17.

USD/JPY fell to 158.8771 from 159.6792 at the Thursday US close and 159.9351 at the same time Thursday morning. Japanese consumer inflation accelerated in October according to data released overnight. The next Bank of Japan meeting is scheduled for December 17-18.

data.title: Ezee Fiber Wins Two 2026 Fierce Network Innovation Awards
data.description:
New Mexico fiber expansion named Broadband Build of the Year;

CEO Matt Marino named Innovator of the Year

HOUSTON, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ezee Fiber won two categories in the 2026 Fierce Network Innovation Awards, a leading telecommunications industry awards program. Its fiber-to-the-home expansion in Albuquerque and Santa Fe was named Broadband Build of the Year, and CEO Matt Marino was named Innovator of the Year.

The awards were announced and presented Nov. 19 during Broadband Nation Expo at the Hilton Riverside in New Orleans. The ceremony marked the first live, in-person presentation of the awards in the program's more than 15-year history.

New Mexico build recognized for measurable community impact

The Broadband Build of the Year category honors completed builds with measurable community results. At the end of 2022, only about 4% of Bernalillo County and 9% of Santa Fe County could buy fiber at home. Ezee Fiber's $250 million New Mexico expansion, announced in 2023, now offers symmetrical residential speeds up to 8 Gbps and enterprise connectivity up to 400 Gbps, with no data caps.

A July 2026 Ezee Fiber-sponsored study by Dr. Brian Whitacre of Oklahoma State University ties roughly 661 local jobs to the rollout from 2021 to 2024 and estimates $77 million in home-value gains through 2025. More than 95% of the company's New Mexico roles are filled locally, and it has invested $98 million in in-state supply chain spending.

After a 2025 stop-work order in Albuquerque, Ezee Fiber worked with city leaders on "neighbor-first" construction protocols that cut construction-related 311 calls by 47% year over year.

"This award belongs to our New Mexico team," said Pedro Checo, chief operating officer of Ezee Fiber. "New Mexico shows what fiber can do when it's built with local people, local partners and a long-term commitment to the community."

Marino named Innovator of the Year

Since joining as CEO in 2023, Marino has built Ezee Fiber around the customer experience, pairing fast, reliable fiber with 24/7 local customer service. Under his leadership, that model is expanding from Texas and New Mexico into Washington, Illinois, Oregon and Michigan.

"Together, these awards recognize the commitment of our teams to building better networks, delivering exceptional service and earning the trust of customers and communities," Marino said. "Innovation is not simply about technology. It is about how effectively we deliver on our promises, solve problems and create lasting value for the people we serve."

The recognition marks the inaugural presentation of Fierce Network's Innovator of the Year award and highlights the growing influence of emerging fiber providers in an industry historically dominated by much larger companies.

Hiring and recognition continue as the industry contracts

Fierce Network honors add to a growing list of national industry recognitions for Ezee Fiber. PCMag named the company the best overall internet service provider in the U.S. for 2026 and included it among the Best Gaming ISPs (2025, 2026) and Fastest ISPs in the U.S. (2024, 2025).

Ezee Fiber has also earned 65 Speedtest by Ookla awards. A recent edition of Consumer Reports ranked Ezee Fiber among the nation's top 10 internet providers, with consumers praising its value, pricing and simplicity.

The recognition comes as Ezee Fiber continues to expand its network, customer base and workforce across six states. While several major U.S. telecommunications companies have announced substantial workforce reductions, Ezee Fiber continues to invest in new markets and hire employees in sales, field operations, customer service and other functions. The company employs approximately 800 people and is targeting 200,000 customers and 800,000 homes passed by the end of 2026.

For more information about Ezee Fiber and service availability, visit www.ezeefiber.com.

About Ezee Fiber

Ezee Fiber is a rapidly growing fiber internet company delivering premium multi-gigabit service to residential, business and government customers over a 100% fiber-optic network at exceptional value. The company's carrier-grade infrastructure spans Texas, New Mexico, Illinois, Oregon, Michigan and Washington, supported by local teams who live and work in the communities they serve. Ezee Fiber's industry-leading speeds, award-winning customer service and transparent pricing model set the company apart. Learn more at www.ezeefiber.com.

data.title: GRAPHIC-The snowballing selloff in global markets
data.description:
LONDON, Nov 20 (Reuters) - A global financial market rout has taken a major turn for the worse this week as a noxious combination of worries over AI and US interest rates triggered an avalanche of selling from stocks to copper and gold.

1/STOCKS SHOCK

Nerves about a possible bubble in AI and tech stocks started to emerge around the middle of the year. But the selloff really started to snowball last month when it became clear that major economies such as the US would need further interest rate hikes to tame inflation.

Some of the milestones are eye-popping.

Nearly $9 trillion has been wiped off the value of world stocks since they peaked back in August while this week's 17% plunge in Taiwan is the biggest since the early 1990s.

Adding to the worries was this month's hammering of US President Donald Trump's Republican Party, which has cast doubts on how many US data centres will get built. The sudden resignation of Nvidia ( NVDA ) CEO Jensen Huang also rattled investors given the key role the chip company plays in bankrolling the AI industry.

"What concerns me isn't so much the correction in technology stocks... but the possibility of the selling spreading into broader financial markets," said Bruno Schneller, managing director at Erlen Capital Management.

"Even gold has come under pressure, which is interesting given its traditional safe-haven role and may point to investors raising cash rather than simply rotating into defensive assets."

2/TURN UP THE VOL

Wall Street's fear gauge, ​the VIX index of US stock market volatility, reached 30 points on Friday, its highest since late March, as investors rushed to buy protection against market swings.

While the jump isn't yet at the scale of its post-April 2025 "Liberation Day" move, it's getting close and is now at a level that could trigger selling by hedge funds that target fixed levels of volatility.

The European equivalent of the VIX has also hit its highest level since April although other gauges suggest the stress, for now at least, isn't spreading.

The MOVE index, which tracks volatility ​in the US Treasury bond market, remains below last month's highs, as do implied volatility gauges for major currency pairs.

3/COPPER, OIL

The standout mover in metals is copper. A beneficiary of the AI rollout, given high demand for the metal from data centres, it is on course for its steepest weekly drop since April 2025.

Oil, which has been central to this year's inflation worries given how much higher prices have pushed up costs, has taken a back seat in the broader market drama of the last few days, staying in a relatively tight $90-$94 range.

4/BONDS, GOLD

Government bonds are performing well as a safe haven in this latest market turmoil, shrugging off worries about a more aggressive Federal Reserve.

The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield is on track for its biggest weekly fall since April 2025, down 17 basis points so far this week.

Bond yields move inversely to prices.

In Europe, the 10-year German Bund yield is down around 9 bps on Friday alone.

Analysts at Citi said the market could price out US rate hikes, lifting bonds, "if the US equity sell-off should morph into a bursting of the AI bubble."

Gold, however, is failing to play its safe-haven role, down around 1% on Friday to the lowest since September 2025.

5/DOLLAR WRECKING BALL

The dollar has shown that reports of its demise have been greatly exaggerated.

The greenback index, which measures the world's reserve currency against the six other top currencies, has risen to a 19-month high this week.

For the year it is nearly 7% higher against the euro, 3% up on the yen and between 4% and 5% stronger against sterling and the Canadian and kiwi dollars.

Emerging market currencies have been hit too. The added turbulence of a surprise election result has seen Brazil's currency slump more than 8% this month, while Israel's shekel, one of the currencies most correlated with the AI boom, has tumbled almost 5%.

(Reporting by Marc Jones and Alun John, additional reporting by Harry Robertson)

data.title: Fort and Consilium Join Forces to Create a Leading Independent Insurance Brokerage in Quebec

MONTRÉAL, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Fort Insurance & Group Benefits and Consilium Insurance today announced that they are joining forces to create one of Quebec’s largest independent insurance brokerages. The combined firm, which will operate as Fort Insurance & Group Benefits (“Fort”), brings together more than 310 professionals and annual premium volume of more than $300 million.

This transaction brings together two complementary teams who share the same vision for brokerage: an independent approach built on close client relationships and the expertise of the people who deliver it.

“This combination allows us to offer our clients more choice and better solutions in addition to giving our teams new career opportunities. By joining forces, we’re building a stronger organization that aligns with our ambitions,” said Vincent Gaudreau, President and Chief Executive Officer of Fort.

Christian Foisy, founder of Consilium Insurance, will become Fort’s Executive Vice President, Sales & Business Development. “This combination creates more opportunities for our teams while preserving what we have built,” said Foisy. “Together, we have the resources to pursue our ambitions.”

Broader capabilities, a stronger presence

With complementary expertise and offices across several regions of Quebec, Fort now offers a broader range of solutions for individuals and businesses. Its greater scale also gives it a stronger voice with insurance carrier partners, while preserving the close relationships and flexibility that define its brand.

Financial partners committed for the long term

Novacap, already a shareholder of Consilium, is joining forces with the Fonds de solidarité FTQ and Fonds régionaux de solidarité FTQ Montréal — longstanding partners of Fort — to support the company’s next phase of growth. Together, they give Fort the means to accelerate its growth while preserving its Quebec roots and independence as an insurance brokerage.

“With nearly a century of history, Fort has always aimed to be a leading force in the industry. By bringing together teams who share our values and partners who believe in our vision, we can think bigger without losing what sets us apart,” added Vincent Gaudreau.

“We invest in people first. Fort and Consilium bring together two complementary teams, driven by shared values and a common ambition. Novacap is proud to support Fort through this new chapter,” said Jean-Philippe Garant, Partner at Novacap.

data.title: E-Power’s Joint Venture Designated a National-Level “Little Giant” Enterprise by China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
data.description:
DOVER, USA, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- E-Power Inc. ( EPOW ) (“E-Power,” the “Company,” “we” or “our”) , a provider of advanced battery materials and AI Data Center (AIDC) microgrid solutions, today announced that its joint venture, Sunrise (Guizhou) New Energy Materials Co., Ltd. (“Sunrise Guizhou”), has been designated a national-level Specialized, Refined, Distinctive and Innovative (“Little Giant”) enterprise by China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (“MIIT”) as part of the MIIT’s eighth batch of Little Giant designations. Sunrise Guizhou received notice of the designation on October 14, 2026 through the MIIT’s High-Quality SME Gradient Cultivation Platform.

The designation completes the national review process described in the Company’s press release of August 20, 2026, which announced that Sunrise Guizhou had passed provincial review by the Department of Industry and Information Technology of Guizhou Province and was one of 28 enterprises included in the province’s recommendation list for the eighth batch.

The Top Tier of China’s SME Cultivation System

The MIIT’s gradient cultivation system for high-quality small and medium-sized enterprises (“SMEs”) has three tiers: technology-based and innovative SMEs; specialized and sophisticated SMEs, recognized at the provincial level; and Little Giant enterprises, designated at the national level by the MIIT. Only enterprises that already hold provincial specialized and sophisticated SME status may apply for Little Giant designation. The program recognizes SMEs that focus on specific market segments, possess core technologies and strong innovation capabilities, and hold leading positions in their segments.

Applications for the eighth batch were assessed under the MIIT’s revised Measures for the Administration of Gradient Cultivation of High-Quality Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises, issued in January 2026. According to the MIIT’s notice to Sunrise Guizhou, the designation followed preliminary review and recommendation by local authorities, expert review, and internal deliberation by the MIIT. The MIIT’s review uses staged review, random assignment of experts and review tasks, and blind review, and cross-checks application data using data analysis tools. The designation is valid for three years, from July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2029.

Progression Through All Three Tiers

Sunrise Guizhou has advanced through each tier of the system. It was recognized as an innovative SME in April 2023 and as a specialized and sophisticated SME in July 2024, and in May 2025 it was designated a Guizhou Province Key Specialized and Sophisticated SME. The Little Giant designation places it in the system’s top tier.

Sunrise Guizhou manufactures graphite anode materials and develops next-generation anode materials, including silicon-carbon composites and hard carbon for sodium-ion batteries. It was certified as a National High-Tech Enterprise in 2023. In 2024, one of its projects was selected through the “Open Competition” (Jie Bang Gua Shuai) mechanism of an MIIT industrial foundation innovation program and passed final acceptance in December 2024. In May 2025, it received an Excellence Award at the 25th China Patent Awards, granted by the China National Intellectual Property Administration, and in 2026 it participated in drafting the national standard “Porous Carbon for Silicon-Based Anode Materials” .

“This designation completes the national review that followed Guizhou’s provincial recommendation earlier this year, and we see it as recognition of our Guizhou team’s long-standing focus on anode materials,” said Mr. Haiping Hu, the founder, CEO and Chairman of E-Power Inc. ( EPOW ) “Because the designation is reviewed every three years, we intend to keep earning it through continued investment in research, standards work and manufacturing quality.”

About E-Power Inc. ( EPOW )

E-Power Inc. ( EPOW ), through its subsidiaries, joint venture and variable interest entity structure, is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of graphite anode material for lithium-ion batteries. Through its joint venture, the Company operates a plant in Guizhou Province, China, powered by electricity from renewable sources, which contributes to the plant’s competitive production costs and reduced environmental impact in the production of graphite anode material. Mr. Haiping Hu, the founder, CEO and Chairman of the Company, has been a pioneer in the graphite anode industry since 1999. The Company’s management team is composed of experts with years of experience and successful track records in the graphite anode industry. data.title: Taiwan's Stock Pickers Are Walking Out to Bet Their Own Money
data.description:
NEW YORK, Oct. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Fly On Wall Street News Commentary - Taiwan's benchmark stock index was up 62% this year, the best showing of any major equity gauge in the world, when Bloomberg reported on Oct. 16 that some of the island's professional fund managers and analysts are quitting their jobs to invest their own money. Strict rules keep them from trading the very stocks they pick for clients, and in a year when about one in ten stocks in the index has more than doubled, some have decided the trade-off is no longer worth it. Companies and funds mentioned in this article include: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited ( TSM ) [TSMC] , ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. ( ASX ) [ASE] , United Microelectronics Corporation ( UMC ) [UMC] , iShares MSCI Taiwan ETF , The Taiwan Fund, Inc. ( TWN ) .

Watching From Behind the Locker

Taiwan does not ban personal investing outright, but its asset-management code of conduct bars staff from trading a locally listed stock or a linked derivative within seven business days before or after their firm's funds trade it, which in practice rules out personal stock-picking. Fund managers must also lock away their phones, laptops and smartwatches each morning until the market closes at 1:30 p.m. The phone rule was formalized in 2024 to deter insider trading, the Taipei Times reported in July, after six former fund managers from four firms were indicted for front-running trades through the accounts of relatives and friends.

Ken Tsai, 40, a fund manager who until July worked at a large Taiwanese asset manager that Bloomberg did not name, told Bloomberg he made a Taiwanese maker of AI-server data-transfer components his fund's largest holding in 2024. The stock rose more than fivefold in 2025 and about sixfold again this year, but he owned none of it personally. "It left me with a strong sense of relative deprivation," he said. He now works at a private investment firm in Taipei, which was also not named. Pay adds to the pull: Taiwan portfolio managers earn roughly US$124,000 to US$311,000 a year, well below Hong Kong base salaries, according to Bloomberg, citing headhunters and recruitment-firm data.

The private shops they are joining sit outside those rules. They register as private companies with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and do not need asset-management licenses from the Financial Supervisory Commission because they do not raise public money. Brokers told Bloomberg some of them now generate more than NT$10 billion in monthly trading volume, rivaling mid-sized asset managers.

The Rally Behind the Exits

Much of the rally traces back to the AI hardware supply chain. TSMC reported third-quarter revenue of NT$1.49 trillion (US$46.7 billion) on Oct. 15, up 50.9% from a year earlier, while net income jumped 68.7% and gross margin reached 66.4%. It guided fourth-quarter revenue from US$52.3 billion to US$54.3 billion.

Chip packaging and testing has ridden the same wave. ASE Technology ( ASX ) reported September net revenue of NT$88.1 billion, up 45.5% from a year earlier, and third-quarter revenue of NT$244.2 billion, up 44.8%.

Mature-node foundry UMC reported August sales up 30.71% from a year earlier, lifting year-to-date sales 14.66%. In its second-quarter report, the company guided for capacity utilization above 90% in the third quarter and said revenue from its 22/28nm business continues to set record highs.

CONTINUED... Read more market coverage at: flyonwallstreet.com

A Talent Squeeze, Not a Stampede

The numbers point to churn more than an exodus. Fewer than half of Taiwan's 20 largest local equity mutual funds have kept the same portfolio manager for more than three years, according to fund-data site MoneyDJ, and Bloomberg reported that applications for junior roles at some international firms have roughly halved this year. Yet the FSC said the industry's registered headcount actually rose to 4,729 in September from 4,581 at the end of 2025. Firms are responding: the largest foreign asset manager in Taiwan is offering cross-market analyst roles and office rotations to keep staff.

Regulators are paying attention. The FSC said on Oct. 15 it is gathering information and plans to review the rules, balancing market development against conflicts of interest and investor protection. One asset-management executive told Bloomberg there is no easy solution for now.

The Case for the Pros

At least one professionally managed fund has kept pace. The Taiwan Fund ( TWN ), a closed-end fund listed in New York, reported a 47.36% total return for its fiscal quarter ended May 31, against 26.12% for the TAIEX Total Return Index over the same period, with net asset value of US$116.90 a share at the end of that quarter.

Investors who prefer to own the whole market can use the iShares MSCI Taiwan ETF, which holds about US$11.9 billion in assets.

Last week was a reminder of how quickly the math can change. The TAIEX fell 4.6%, its first weekly decline in five weeks, as a technology selloff spread and TSMC CEO C.C. Wei warned of macroeconomic uncertainty and weak consumer demand, according to Trading Economics. In New York, TSMC's shares fell 8.98% from the Oct. 9 close to $412.61 on Oct. 16, ASE dropped 14.86% to $39.53, UMC slid 13.68% to $19.82, the iShares fund lost 7.04% to $106.26 and The Taiwan Fund ( TWN ) declined 8.78% to $94.18, according to Stock Analysis data. For the managers who just traded a salary for their own account, those swings now land on them.

data.title: Robinhood faces shareholder challenge as SEC loosens proxy oversight
data.description:
Nov 20 (Reuters) - A shareholder activist group called for online brokerage Robinhood to review its proxy-voting platform, concerned that retail investors aren't getting fair choices as financial regulators weaken balloting rules for corporate annual meetings.

Robinhood and its Say investor-communications arm are at the center of changes coming to contests like director elections or CEO pay approvals. Robinhood worked with Tesla to create a way for retail investors to cast their ballots automatically that won approval from the US Securities and Exchange Commission in September.

Backers say such retail-voting plans will increase retail investors' voting participation rates, even as the SEC takes steps that could eliminate shareholder proposals at corporate meetings. Critics say Tesla and others like ExxonMobil are designing their programs to unfairly channel votes in favor of management recommendations.

A shareholder resolution filed with Robinhood for its next annual meeting, seen by Reuters, could spark debate about the role of investor rights. In the resolution the activist group As You Sow says Robinhood limits customers to using its own voting platform that requires a "painstaking and time-consuming challenge" to vote on individual corporate ballot items, rather than using third-party voting services.

It also notes Robinhood's work with Tesla's management-friendly voting option. The limited voting choices create legal and reputational risks, said As You Sow in its resolution, which calls for Robinhood to review offering clients more ways to vote, "including an independent voting service of their choice."

As You Sow leaders said ideally Robinhood might offer something like Vanguard's voting program which casts prorated shares of funds' votes according to investors' preferences. Vanguard clients can select among voting policies like one that tends to support environmental and social shareholder resolutions, or one that supports management recommendations.

Robinhood "shouldn't be limiting choices," said Danielle Fugere, As You Sow president, in an interview. "You should get to choose. That's what voting is all about."

Robinhood representatives did not respond to messages seeking comment.

(Reporting by Ross Kerber; Editing by Sonali Paul)

The report, which follows a months-long investigation into the adoption of Chinese AI models into the American tech stack, said Cursor "informed the committees" of those plans. Vacation-rental firm Airbnb and food delivery firm DoorDash also engaged with the investigation about their use of Chinese AI models, according to CNBC.

Earlier this year, SpaceX acquired the startup behind Cursor, Anysphere, in a $60 billion all-stock deal to boost its presence in the lucrative enterprise AI tools market.

SpaceX is developing its Grok family of AI models in collaboration with Cursor, which has been involved in their training.

data.title: Anthropic's post-debut stumble delivers reality check for AI trade
data.description:
Nov 20 (Reuters) - Anthropic's post-listing slide deepened the gloom over the AI sector on Friday, underscoring how even one of the most eagerly anticipated listings in history has struggled to revive investor enthusiasm.

Widely seen as a proxy for the AI trade, Anthropic's listing had been viewed as a potential boost for an industry struggling to regain momentum after a turbulent stretch.

But the stock was last trading at $88.25, about 9% below where it closed following Thursday's smooth debut, giving Anthropic a fully diluted valuation of about $1.6 trillion and a market capitalization of about $1.2 trillion based on shares outstanding.

The stock could find support later in the year. London-based index rebalance analytics firm Intropic estimates index-tracking funds could account for purchases of up to 30% of Anthropic's shares by year-end.

Near-term volatility, however, could persist as the initial euphoria around the listing fades and investors assess whether a valuation of about 40 times sales over the past 12 months can be sustained.

"We favor patience on Anthropic and recommend evaluating the company as it reports public results," said Kaush Amin, head of private market investing at US Bank Asset Management, adding that the current valuation "assumes years of rapid growth."

The debut has also done little to ease broader concerns about the health of the AI trade. Wall Street's main indexes ended sharply lower on Thursday, while futures pointed to further declines on Friday.

Among the Magnificent Seven stocks, Nvidia and Meta Platforms fell more than 3% each in premarket trading, while Amazon and Microsoft dropped more than 2%.

Chip stocks also slid, with AMD and Sandisk down over 6% each and Intel losing more than 4%.

The focus now shifts to a potential OpenAI listing, which would be another major test of investors' appetite for AI stocks. OpenAI has indicated it may go public next year.

PARALLELS WITH SPACEX

Anthropic's IPO has drawn parallels with Elon Musk's SpaceX, which went public in June after the second-biggest IPO on record.

Anthropic raised $93.5 billion in its IPO after underwriters exercised an option to buy additional shares, surpassing SpaceX's $85.7 billion haul to become the biggest listing on record.

While the companies have different business models, some investors have pointed to SpaceX's sharp swings in the weeks after its debut as a reason for caution over buying Anthropic immediately after its listing.

"There's going to be some volatility like we had with SpaceX. A lot of people are going to have FOMO. I don't think there's any need to get on it on the first trade," said Rob Hackel, CEO of financial advisory and brokerage firm RF Lafferty & Co.

SpaceX shares fell about 6%.

Retail investors traded about $772 million of Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most for an IPO debut since Vanda Research began tracking the data in 2012.

The stock's sharp swings have left investors weighing whether to bet on a rebound or brace for further losses. Options trading, due to begin next week, could add to the volatility.

"It's not a good environment for Anthropic at the moment," said Carsten Hesse, head of index events at Berenberg.

Competition could also weigh on investor sentiment.

Apple is developing an AI agent that can perform tasks on behalf of users, entering a market already being pursued by OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, Bloomberg News reported on Friday.

(Reporting by Niket Nishant in Bengaluru and Vidya Ranganathan in London; Editing by Anil D'Silva)

data.title: HireClix Introduces Verified Apply for Career Sites, Integrating Human Verification in the Application Process to Improve the Quality of Applicants
data.description:
HireClix Career Site adds new security solution to core platform functionality and introduces a human check between “Apply” and employers’ ATS, combating fraudulent job applications without added friction to the candidate experience

GLOUCESTER, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- HireClix, a leading recruitment marketing services company, today announced a significant enhancement to its Career Site platform in the form of its new Verified Apply solution. The solution is a one-second human check that filters out automated noise, protecting candidate quality and saving on recruiter time, while keeping the candidate experience fast, familiar and welcoming for human candidates. Verified Apply adds a brief, invisible-by-design human check at the exact moment a candidate clicks Apply, allowing candidates to complete a near-instant verification and continue straight into the application experience.

Career sites are increasingly under pressure by non-human traffic (NHT) or automated bot traffic – from automation that can cause havoc on the site all the way into the candidate application pool. This enhancement will upgrade the quality of the job seekers by setting a roadblock for spam apply engines and many bad actors. When these types of aggressive tactics are used they show up in the form of hundreds or thousands of applications. Such a glut of candidates wastes significant recruiter time, sorting through low-quality or fraudulent submissions, while real candidates are buried in the pile. Verified Apply is powered by Cloudflare Turnstile, the same technology trusted by many of the web's largest platforms. Rather than asking candidates to prove they're human by solving a puzzle, it quietly confirms that a real browser, on a real device, is making the request. Verification is confirmed before the candidate is ever handed off to an employer’s applicant tracking system, so a passing result can be verified as a human.

“Everyone knows that all bad actors can’t be stopped, but adding Verified Apply to the HireClix Career Site Solution solves many of the challenges in today’s recruiting world faced by all employers from enterprise to the mid-market. Leveraging Cloudflare Turnstile for our solution enables us to utilize the best of the technology in the consumer marketplace and apply it to our client’s recruiting challenges,” said Neil Costa, CEO and Founder of HireClix. “We continue to invest in a career site solution that improves the candidate experience while also serving the client’s needs to get better quality applicants so they can fill their open roles.”

The Verified Apply solution serves as a frictionless alternative to other forms of verification, reducing scripted, bulk and fraudulent applications before they reach the ATS, thus saving recruiter time spent reviewing mismatched or low-quality applications.

On the candidate side, the experience is designed to be fast and unobtrusive:

  • A candidate clicks Apply on the careers site job detail page.
  • A branded, on-page verification appears as Verified Apply activates.
  • Most candidates pass with little or no interaction – Cloudflare Turnstile often confirms they are human without extra steps.
  • The candidate continues directly into the existing application process.

Verified Apply is also built to protect candidate privacy. It does not collect resumes, names, or application answers; it does not change or replace the existing application system; and it does not share traffic or configuration across clients. Any handoff data (such as the approved Apply destination, optional job ID, and attribution parameters) is short-lived and used only to complete the verification step. Every client runs on its own dedicated, isolated verification configuration – nothing is pooled or shared. Employers can keep existing analytics and reporting in place.

“The future of recruiting is not about generating the highest number of applications, but rather giving recruiters the tools needed to ensure they can meaningfully engage with high-quality candidates,” added Costa. “Verified Apply allows employers to preserve the candidate experience, a consistent and fully branded career site, reduce bulk and automated bots to mitigate risk, all while protecting the employer’s resources and recruiters’ time.”

To learn more about HireClix’s Verified Apply solution visit: https://www.hireclix.com/recruitment-marketing/career-site-solutions-verified-apply

HireClix is a recruitment marketing agency that provides full agency of record and strategic talent acquisition services to help clients achieve their recruiting and employer branding goals. HireClix also provides full career site creative design and development services on a state-of-the-art and secure content management system for employers, leading to enhancements in the candidate experience, placement within search engines and AI agents and improved overall employer branding. HireClix’s recruitment advertising agency services include programmatic job board media buying and the HireClix Employer Brand Network, by targeting key audiences so employers can reach passive candidates on consumer sites. In addition, the HireClix Advanced Analytics Dashboard (HAAD) blends advertising metrics, career site analytics and data from any ATS to give visibility to quality applications and cost per hire. Snow co-founded September Letters with her friend, entrepreneur Jaspre Guest as a community where people share letters about love, connection, and their own experiences, rooted in the belief that sharing our stories can bring people closer together. Their book, September Letters: Finding Strength and Connection in Sharing Our Stories, collects letters, notes and conversations from friends, experts and the September Letters community. The idea began with a story Snow carried in her back pocket as a teenager, an article about another woman's experience that resonated with her. The book includes a symbolic pocket for readers to keep a letter of their own.

“We believe in fostering a community and that your home is a place where you feel safe and connected,” said Brittany Snow. “So we’re [working with] Bilt and September Letters to bring a mailbox to your building, where people can write letters to each other, your neighbors, your doorman, even to yourself. What we’re seeing is that people want to connect and share their stories with other human beings who have similar stories, so it’s important now more than ever.”

This month, Bilt is bringing that idea to where Members live. Members can write a letter right in the Bilt app, to themselves or to anyone who could use a little warmth, and choose to keep it private or have the chance to share it with the Bilt community. Co-branded Bilt × September Letters mailboxes are also arriving in the lobbies of select Bilt Alliance buildings, where residents can write a letter to a neighbor, a member of their building staff, or their future self, or reflect on what home means to them. Members can also redeem the September Letters book in the Bilt Collection, and join Snow and Guest for a Member-exclusive brunch in New York City to welcome the holiday season.

Bringing that into the Bilt app and the lobbies our Members walk through every day is a meaningful way to close out the year. And of course, we're excited she's helping some of our Members win free rent along the way.”

data.title: Genius Group Updates Shareholders on Impact of Anthropic’s Record IPO on its AI Treasury
data.description:
Anthropic joins SpaceX as Genius Group’s second AI Treasury look-through holding to go public since the Company’s first investments in June 2026

Anthropic’s valuation has increased 295% from its valuation when the Company gained pre-IPO Anthropic exposure during its first AI Treasury investment

AI Treasury also includes pre-IPO exposure to OpenAI, Databricks and Anduril

SINGAPORE, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Genius Group Limited ( GNS ) , a leading AI-powered education group, is providing today an update to its shareholders on its AI Treasury, further to Anthropic’s initial public offering yesterday.

On May 27, 2026, the Company’s Board of Directors approved the launch of the Genius AI Treasury, with a plan to deploy up to US$100 million of initial capital as the first phase of a US$800 million, five-year investment program into companies leading the development of Artificial General Intelligence (“AGI”). The Company’s AGI Infinity Portfolio is structured to provide shareholders with look-through exposure to frontier AI companies through SEC-registered, publicly traded closed-end funds.

Anthropic, the frontier AI laboratory and creator of the Claude family of AI models, is the largest look-through holding in the AI Treasury, representing approximately 18% of the Company’s initial investments and 21% of the Company’s AI Treasury as of today’s date. On November 18, 2026, Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $83 per share, raising approximately $81.3 billion in the largest initial public offering on record by initial offering size[1]. Shares began trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on November 19, 2026 under the ticker symbol “ANT”, with the offering valuing the company at approximately $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.

At the time of the Company’s first AI Treasury investments in June 2026, the most recent reported valuations of Anthropic and SpaceX at the time were $380 billion (February 2026 Series G funding round) and $1.25 trillion (SpaceX and xAI combined, February 2026), as cited in the Company’s August 27, 2026 release[2].

Anthropic was subsequently valued at $965 billion at its May 2026 Series H funding round, an increase of 154%, and at approximately $1.5 trillion at its IPO, an increase of 295% on its valuation at the time of the Company’s investment.

SpaceX, which listed on Nasdaq on June 12, 2026 at an IPO valuation of approximately $1.77 trillion, had a market capitalization of approximately $1.95 trillion based on its closing share price on November 18, 2026, more than 50% above the combined SpaceX and xAI valuation at the time of the Company’s investment.

Analysts are forecasting further growth. The average of the five analyst price targets published to date for Anthropic is $116.38, 40% above its IPO price[3], and the consensus analyst price target for SpaceX is $256.41 per 24/7 Wall St.[4]

Roger James Hamilton, CEO of Genius Group ( GNS ), stated: “We launched our AI Treasury strategy in May 2026 with the goal of giving our shareholders exposure to the most transformative companies in superintelligence. Yesterday, Anthropic joined SpaceX as the two private companies that AI Treasury had high exposure to that have since become publicly listed companies. The two companies are now trading on NASDAQ at a combined valuation of over $3 trillion. The AI economy is growing rapidly, and we believe our shareholders are positioned to benefit from this historic AI super-trend.”

“Genius Group has recently been trading at a share price which is at a fraction of its Net Asset Value Per Share. We believe that what we see as a potential market mispricing will increasingly be seen as an opportunity by long term investors as the value of our assets and our treasury continues to grow.”

The AI Treasury was established with the intention of giving Genius Group ( GNS ) shareholders exposure to the growth of the AI economy alongside the Company’s AI-powered education business. The AI economy is growing rapidly. Gartner forecasts worldwide AI spending of $2.67 trillion in 2026, an increase of 49.5% on 2025, rising to $3.64 trillion in 2027[5].

Image: https://ml.globenewswire.com/Resource/Download/62dcb837-ea4f-48cc-986e-9a060d89b333/image2.png

The Company’s initial investment of US$657,100, made in June 2026 in Destiny Tech100 and Fundrise Innovation Fund, was the first step in the Company’s AI Treasury program. The Company intends to continue adding to its AI Treasury and, as announced on August 27, 2026, aims to fund its growth through perpetual preferred equity rather than ordinary shares.

Based on the funds’ most recent disclosures, the Company’s largest look-through holdings within its AI Treasury are Anthropic (21.3%), OpenAI (12.4%), SpaceX (7.3%) and Databricks (4.1%), compared to Anthropic (17.6%), SpaceX (11.7%), OpenAI (7.4%) and Databricks (5.4%) at the time of investment[6]:

The Company believes the success of the Anthropic and SpaceX IPOs, together with the ongoing demand for AI services and tools to power the world’s future economy, reinforce its thesis that by growing its AI treasury alongside its AI-powered education business preparing its students for the future, shareholders can benefit from both the human and capital opportunities created by the coming post-AGI economy.

Image: https://ml.globenewswire.com/Resource/Download/669fc528-f98d-4f9a-9cfe-8628835eebc9/image3.png

Genius Group ( GNS ) believes the benefit of its Treasury strategy will be realized over a long term horizon. By example, over the next five years, analyst revenue forecasts for Anthropic rise from between $52 billion to $53 billion in 2026 through to between $270 billion to $280 billion in 2028[3], and to between $505 billion and $685 billion in 2030[3][7]. Analyst consensus revenue estimates for SpaceX rise from $49.0 billion in 2026 to $181.3 billion in 2027[4], $330.9 billion in 2028[8] and $492.5 billion in 2030[9]. This analyst consensus equates to a forecasted 10x revenue growth by 2030.

data.title: Comstock Announces Grand Opening of Ebbitt House at Reston Station
data.description:
First-ever expansion of D.C.’s iconic Old Ebbitt Grill opens its doors at 1860 Reston Row Plaza in The Row at Reston Station

RESTON, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Comstock Holding Companies, Inc. ( CHCI ) (“Comstock”), a leading real estate company specializing in the development, acquisition, operation, and management of mixed-use, transit-oriented properties and data center developments, today announced the grand opening of Ebbitt House at Reston Station. Located at 1860 Reston Row Plaza in The Row at Reston Station, the 12,000-square-foot restaurant opens its doors to the public today at 11 a.m. and will welcome guests daily. Reservations are now open via EbbittHouse.com and OpenTable.

Named after the original 1856 boarding house that gave rise to the legendary Old Ebbitt Grill, Ebbitt House marks the first-ever expansion of the storied brand outside of downtown D.C. in its 170-year history. Designed as a contemporary evolution of the D.C. landmark, the venue brings the signature Clyde’s Restaurant Group (“CRG”) hospitality, classic American fare, lively bar culture, and renowned raw bar to Northern Virginia’s premier mixed-use, transit-oriented neighborhood.

Ebbitt House features more than 400 seats spread across its 275+ guest dining room, two private dining rooms, and all-season patio. Two indoor bars anchor the main dining areas that are complemented by a dedicated outdoor patio bar. A full oyster and raw bar sits at the heart of the restaurant, carrying forward one of Old Ebbitt Grill’s best-known traditions, alongside a menu of elevated American classics that have drawn generations of guests to the original. Located steps from the Wiehle-Reston East Station on Metro's Silver Line, Ebbitt House is positioned as a destination for business lunches, after-work gatherings, and celebratory events alike.

“Ebbitt House is one of the most anticipated restaurant openings in Northern Virginia's history, and we are proud that CRG chose Reston Station for the first-ever expansion of such an iconic brand,” said Tim Steffan, Chief Operating Officer of Comstock. “Its arrival, alongside the JW Marriott Reston Station and our growing roster of best-in-class dining and retail, further cements Reston Station as the premier place to live, work, stay, and gather in the Dulles Corridor.”

The opening of Ebbitt House in Reston Station also marks CRG’s return to the area. CRG previously operated Clyde’s of Reston at Reston Town Center for more than 30 years, and several familiar faces from that team have rejoined to lead Ebbitt House, including General Manager Ajay Bhatia and Executive Chef Diego Ramirez.

"Reston has always held a special place in our history, and we are thrilled to return to this thriving community with a bold new chapter of the Ebbitt story," said John McDonnell, President and CEO of Clyde’s Restaurant Group. "Ebbitt House honors and expands upon the traditions guests love about Old Ebbitt Grill, from our renowned raw bar to our classic American hospitality, while introducing an elevated menu and an energetic, modern space tailored specifically for Reston Station."

Reston Station is among the largest and most prominent mixed-use, transit-oriented developments in the Mid-Atlantic region, covering approximately 90 acres spanning across the Dulles Toll Road and surrounding the Wiehle-Reston East Station on Metro’s Silver Line. Its first two phases feature five Trophy-Class office buildings, two luxury high-rise apartment towers, and Virginia’s first and only JW Marriott – a 28-story tower that includes the world-class JW Marriott Reston Station hotel and the ultra-premium JW Marriott Residences, both of which set the new standard for luxury in the D.C. region. A growing collection of signature dining, retail, and wellness options include Ebbitt House, Founding Farmers, Davio’s Northern Italian Steakhouse, Starbucks, a 55,000-square-foot VIDA Fitness and Spa, CVS, and more. For more information, please visit RestonStation.com.

AUSTIN, Texas, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Phunware, Inc. ( PHUN ) (“Phunware” or the “Company”) , a mobile-first AI-enabled guest intelligence platform company focusing on hotels, resorts, health systems and other large complex properties, has filed its definitive proxy statement and today issued a letter from its Board of Directors (the “Board”) to stockholders ahead of the Company’s 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders (the “Annual Meeting”), which will be held virtually on December 17, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time.

The letter outlines the recommendation of the Board’s Special Committee on Election Matters for stockholders to re-elect Board Chairperson Elliot Han for another term as a Class II director, the Company's progress and prospects under its 2.0 Strategy, and its responses to the proxy materials filed by Goldenwise Capital Group Limited (“Goldenwise”). Shareholders of record as of October 19, 2026, are entitled to vote at the Annual Meeting.

What You Need to Know Before You Vote.

At the December 17, 2026 Annual Meeting, stockholders will vote on a nominee to fill one Board seat. The Special Committee urges you to vote “FOR” Chairperson Elliot Han on the WHITE proxy card.

  • Mr. Han has played a key role in strengthening Phunware’s finances and leadership. He championed the approximately $104 million capital raise in 2024 that resolved liquidity challenges. As of September 30, 2026, Phunware ( PHUN ) held approximately $86.7 million in cash and cash equivalents, with no debt. Further, as Chairperson, led the appointment of Dmitry Kroshka as permanent CEO, ending a period of interim leadership.
  • Goldenwise has not made a convincing case. It has not made any proposals establishing how replacing Mr. Han would improve Phunware’s new strategy, customer acquisition, product commercialization, recurring revenue growth or other critical performance metrics. Stockholders deserve a clear explanation of how Goldenwise’s nominee would improve the Company and its prospects.
  • Mr. Ding’s disclosure record raises serious questions. He answered “No” when asked whether he had been involved in any prior proceedings involving allegations of a breach of fiduciary duty or similar conduct, despite being named in a 2020 lawsuit alleging professional negligence and breach of fiduciary duty involving approximately $1.3 million in alleged investment losses. Separately, Goldenwise only provided more fullsome public disclosure of its short call and short put options after Phunware ( PHUN ) questioned the accuracy and completeness of these disclosures. Shareholders deserve complete and accurate information from Goldenwise as they are being asked to vote in favor of its nominee for the Board.
  • Ms. Zhang’s commercial ties and track record warrant scrutiny. Her firm, Trunity Partners, had a business relationship with Goldenwise in 2025, and she served alongside Mr. Ding on Moberg Pharma’s board for just under eight months, where she was not re-elected in May 2026. Her independence from Goldenwise and what relevant experience she would bring to Phunware’s Board deserve scrutiny.
  • An independent review concluded Mr. Han is the stronger choice. A Special Committee of independent directors, with Mr. Han recused, evaluated both candidates. He brings a wealth of relevant public-market leadership experience, capital-markets and finance expertise, legal training, governance experience as Audit Committee chair and audit committee financial expert, and a hands-on role shaping and implementing the Phunware ( PHUN ) 2.0 Strategy. Ms. Zhang’s background is not additive to the Board’s aggregate skillset. Mr. Han’s extensive knowledge of Phunware ( PHUN ) 2.0 supports continuity as the Company works to convert its investments into signed customer agreements and recurring revenues.

How to Vote

Vote FOR Elliot Han only, on the WHITE proxy card, by Internet, telephone or mail, by 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on December 16, 2026. Discard any GOLD card: a later-dated GOLD card cancels your WHITE vote. Questions? Call Alliance Advisors toll-free at 1-888-244-0487.

Letter to Stockholders

Dear Stockholders:

We believe Phunware ( PHUN ) is at a critical point in its evolution and transition. The Phunware Board and management team have been strengthened, a new vision and strategy referred to as “Phunware 2.0” is now being implemented, and the related hospitality and healthcare intelligence platforms, modules and products are in development. We are very focused on finalizing and adopting our 2027 operating plan and budget for Phunware ( PHUN ) 2.0 and completing and converting our 2.0 Strategy into revenues and enterprise value for our stockholders. We believe that continuity and uninterrupted execution at the top are very important to completing the 2.0 Strategy and ensuring those investments turn into growth for stockholders.

At Phunware’s 2026 Annual Meeting on December 17, 2026, stockholders will elect one Class II director to a three-year term. The Board’s nominee is Chairperson Elliot Han. Goldenwise Capital Group Limited, a Hong Kong-based investment manager led by its founder Mr. Huakun Richard Ding, has put forward Ms. Xuan Zhang in opposition to Mr. Han.

Stockholders should carefully examine the record, relationships, and objectives of anyone seeking Board influence. Mr. Ding began engaging with Phunware ( PHUN ) only this year. Against that limited history (and as discussed in more detail below), the discrepancy in his signed director questionnaire, Ms. Zhang’s commercial ties to Goldenwise and Mr. Ding, and the absence of a specific operating plan or alternative strategy presented by Mr. Ding warrant heightened scrutiny before stockholders entrust his nominee with a seat on the Board. In our view, Goldenwise has been far more specific about the Board influence it wants than the value its nominee would create for Phunware ( PHUN ) and its stockholders.

The question is not whether Ms. Zhang has useful qualifications: the question is whether replacing Mr. Han would make the Board stronger and improve Phunware ( PHUN ) and its prospects. The Board’s Special Committee on Election Matters concluded it would not, by concluding, among other items, that:

Mr. Han has delivered. He championed a capital raising strategy that resolved near-term liquidity challenges in 2024; he led the Board’s appointment of a permanent CEO, ending a period of interim leadership, paired with the installment of fuller executive bench; and he strongly supported and provided oversight and guidance on a near daily basis for implementation of our new Phunware ( PHUN ) 2.0 Strategy. Mr. Han went above and beyond to use his first term to lay a strong foundation for future growth, and his renomination ensures the Board can build on it without disruption.

Goldenwise has offered no plan. Despite repeated Board invitations to do so, Goldenwise failed to present any other specific operating plan or alternative strategy for Phunware ( PHUN ). Goldenwise now appears to support the 2.0 Strategy, and require an operating plan and budget, with spending requirements and dated milestones - all of which the Board intends to do for 2027.

The Special Committee recommends that you vote FOR Chairperson Elliot Han on the WHITE proxy card.

Why the Special Committee Recommends Elliot Han

Mr. Han has served on the Board as an independent director since January 2024 and as Chairperson since October 2025. He also chairs the Audit Committee and is designated an audit committee financial expert. His experience includes senior roles at Cantor Fitzgerald, the New York Stock Exchange, and Goldman Sachs, in addition to practicing corporate law at Freshfields. He is currently the Chief Investment Officer of C1 Fund Inc., a publicly traded closed-end investment fund, and a Partner at PGP Capital Advisors.

For stockholders, we believe the most important qualifications for a director at Phunware ( PHUN ) are:

  • Direct knowledge of Phunware’s business, technology, and 2.0 Strategy to challenge and support management and evaluate execution.
  • Financial and transactional expertise to oversee funding decisions, capital allocation, and inorganic growth.
  • Governance and leadership experience to support effective oversight and transparency as the Company moves forward.

As a Board member, Mr. Han advocated for and facilitated Phunware’s completion and utilization of its 2024 at-the-market equity financing program, through which the Company raised approximately $104 million. This capital addressed significant near-term liquidity needs and materially strengthened Phunware’s balance sheet and reduced debt, providing Phunware ( PHUN ) with the financial flexibility to pursue a strategic reset, adapt to macro headwinds, invest in strategy and product development, and evaluate inorganic growth opportunities. Since the commencement of his Board chairmanship in October 2025, Mr. Han helped develop and advance the Company's strategic pivot to Phunware ( PHUN ) 2.0, pushing Phunware ( PHUN ) from a legacy wayfinding and enterprise mobile development company to the AI-powered Guest Intelligence Platform phase and enabling execution of the strategy by helping appoint Dmitry Kroshka as permanent CEO and assembling an experienced product, marketing, sales, and finance team of employees and senior advisors to implement Phunware ( PHUN ) 2.0. He sharpened the Company’s focus and promoted operating discipline around defined platforms and related modules, products and customer propositions.

Importantly, Mr. Han’s contributions to the Board and the Company extend beyond financing and strategy. He has chaired the Compensation Committee, during which time he helped oversee CEO succession and disciplined executive and employee incentives, including conserving capital and aligning leadership incentives with the Company’s turnaround and performance. He has chaired the Audit Committee, during which he oversaw financial reporting, external audits, compliance, and risk controls. He has also led the Strategic Transactions Committee’s oversight of potential acquisitions and capital deployment. Mr. Han demonstrated leadership during a transformational turnaround period, navigating the Company through organizational changes and overseeing the Company’s responses to litigation matters while limiting management distraction. His level of commitment has been demonstrated through his attendance at all Board and committee meetings, substantive travel, preparation, participation, and substantial availability for Company matters.

To ensure an independent evaluation of the director candidates, the Board established a Special Committee on Election Matters, composed of independent directors Quyen Du and Ed Lu; Mr. Han was recused from such deliberations. After weighing the qualifications and fit of all candidates, the Board’s collective capabilities, and the Company’s current and foreseeable needs, the Special Committee determined that Mr. Han’s demonstrated contributions, independent judgment, and unique combination of capital markets, technology investments, legal, corporate finance, and transactional expertise, together with his governance and leadership experience and deep knowledge of Phunware ( PHUN ) and the 2.0 Strategy, made him the clear best choice. Continuity alone does not entitle a director to re-election, but it is extremely valuable at present because of Mr. Han’s specific experience, institutional knowledge of Phunware’s business, operating and management history, demonstrated leadership through periods of market and organizational transitions, oversight, and complementary fit as Chairperson and a member of the Board.

Why Replacing Mr. Han with Goldenwise’s Nominee Would Not Benefit Stockholders

The Special Committee is aware of Ms. Zhang’s qualifications and experience in investment management, capital allocation, and strategic advisory work. However, the materials provided and reviewed did not establish a sustained record of experience which the Board is focused on, including direct responsibility for commercial scaling, go-to-market experience, deep domain knowledge in hospitality and healthcare, AI, platform launches, executive management and operating leadership, and post-acquisition integration experience. In light of the Company’s needs and existing Board composition, these were and are important considerations for new directors as Phunware ( PHUN ) moves its AI-powered Guest Intelligence Platform and other components of Phunware ( PHUN ) 2.0 towards commercialization.

Ms. Zhang’s known public-company board experience consisted principally of approximately eight months on the board of Moberg Pharma, a company listed in Sweden. Although proposed for re-election, Ms. Zhang did not retain her seat at Moberg’s May 21, 2026 annual meeting, when stockholders elected an alternative slate that excluded her. Ms. Zhang's director questionnaire described her experience with investment and oversight frameworks, but the Committee did not find and Goldenwise has not shown sufficiently specific support for the proposition that her background and experience would improve Phunware’s product-market fit, technology expertise, commercialization milestones, or decisions about potential operating decisions or strategic alternatives. Also, her disclosed biography does not identify service on the board of a U.S.-listed company, and Goldenwise has not shown how her experience would strengthen the Board’s existing expertise in U.S. public-company governance and financing or in Phunware’s business.

The question for stockholders is not whether Ms. Zhang possesses useful professional qualifications. It is whether replacing Mr. Han with Ms. Zhang would strengthen the Board or improve the Company or its prospects, in particular the Company’s implementation of its 2.0 Strategy. The Committee concluded that her investment expertise and advisory background did not establish a sufficiently differentiated contribution in key areas of interest to the Board to offset the loss of Mr. Han’s demonstrated capital-markets, corporate legal, transaction, governance, and Phunware ( PHUN )-specific experience or meet the anticipated operational needs in the Company’s next phase in the 2.0 Strategy. As such, the Committee supported and recommended Mr. Han’s renomination.

Progress Under Phunware’s 2.0 Strategy

Since February 2025, two new independent directors joined the Board: Quyen Du, formerly Head of Corporate Strategy and Development of Condé Nast, and Ed Lu, Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer of Fandom. In May 2026, under Mr. Han’s Chairmanship, the Board appointed Dmitry Kroshka as Chief Executive Officer, ending a period of interim CEO leadership and establishing a clear direction for the Company's 2.0 Strategy.

Under the 2.0 Strategy, Phunware ( PHUN ) is bringing together its mobile, location-aware, and customer-engagement capabilities with AI to develop a shared intelligence platform for hospitality, healthcare, and other complex property verticals. We are excited about Phunware’s prospects under the 2.0 Strategy and believe it will be very beneficial to building long-term value for stockholders. Please see our stockholder letter released in October 2026, which can be accessed here, and our investor deck also posted in October 2026, which can be accessed here, for more information and detail on our 2.0 Strategy and recent milestones.

We have ample liquidity to implement and execute our 2.0 Strategy, including through inorganic growth opportunities. As of September 30, 2026, Phunware ( PHUN ) held approximately $86.7 million in cash and cash equivalents with no debt.

Your Board and management team remain focused on disciplined technology and data development, product sales and revenues, capital allocation and inorganic growth opportunities, demonstrating commercial progress, and keeping stockholders informed as we execute the 2.0 Strategy.

Goldenwise Has Not Presented a Specific Operating Plan or Alternative Strategy

We welcome stockholder input and recognize that every investor has the right to question our performance, strategy, and governance. However, a request for Board representation should be supported by a clear explanation of what would change and how stockholders would benefit.

Goldenwise has not proposed a specific operating plan or alternative strategy for Phunware’s business or growth or explained how its nominee would improve Phunware ( PHUN ) or its execution of the 2.0 Strategy. The Goldenwise materials provided so far are long on criticism and short on constructive substance. The Company invited Mr. Ding, on multiple occasions, to present specific proposals on product, strategy, acquisitions, capital allocation, and stockholder communications. To date, he has failed to present any such proposals. This is consistent with the pattern Goldenwise has shown throughout: demand Board representation, focus on broad generic themes that Phunware ( PHUN ) is already addressing, fail to engage on substance and details, and then accuse the Company of stonewalling.

Goldenwise’s demands for Board representation have shifted considerably. In April 2026, Mr. Ding urged the Board to add two or three directors. In June 2026, he proposed expanding the Board from three (3) to six (6) members and subsequently submitted four potential candidates, including himself. Goldenwise is now seeking to have one nominee elected to fill the single available seat. The number of seats sought has changed, but the demand for Board influence, without a specific operating plan or alternative strategy, reflects, in our view, an unfocused and undeveloped proposal. Stockholders should expect a clear, focused and developed plan and greater conviction from someone seeking to reshape the Board. As noted above, there is no need to reshape the Board to implement Phunware ( PHUN ) 2.0 with appropriate operating plan and budget: that will occur, and we welcome shareholder input on implementation of the adopted plan.

On broad themes and engagement, Goldenwise’s own proxy materials document discussions with the Company’s legal team on April 14, 2026, and meetings with the Board on May 15 and June 30, 2026, regarding those themes. The Company also prepared and offered to enter into a confidentiality agreement with Goldenwise and Mr. Ding to enable deeper discussions that could involve nonpublic information. Goldenwise’s proxy states that Mr. Ding declined on June 5, because the agreement might restrict further stock purchases or otherwise disadvantage stockholders. Confidentiality agreements of this kind are customary when an investor seeks access to nonpublic information. They protect all stockholders by ensuring that no single investor has access to information that other investors do not have when making trading decisions. Goldenwise’s later disclosures of short call and short put positions alongside its shareholdings reinforced, in the Company’s view, the importance of those protections. If Goldenwise and Mr. Ding signed the agreement, the Company believes the parties would have had a fuller and more meaningful dialogue.

Stockholders Deserve a Full and Accurate Context

Goldenwise’s criticisms of director compensation and leadership changes omit important details and context.

The August 2026 equity awards Goldenwise cites were granted under Phunware’s Outside Director Compensation Policy, which was adopted by the Board under a prior Chairperson who is no longer on the Board in June 2024 and benchmarked to market practice, well before Goldenwise began accumulating its reported position. The policy provides for non-discretionary annual director restricted stock unit awards with a stated value of $150,000. Goldenwise also mischaracterizes these awards by suggesting that these awards for Board service are discretionary, which they are not, and that these awards should have had an acquisition cost, which would be extremely uncommon and inconsistent with market practice.

Board compensation is also now paid in arrears rather than in advance for quarterly board services rendered, which further aligns directors with stockholders. Given Phunware’s internal resource challenges and the critical issues that it has been facing, Mr. Han and the other directors have consistently committed more time than is customary throughout their respective Board tenures.

On leadership changes, two of the three CEO transitions Goldenwise highlights occurred before Mr. Han became Chairperson in October 2025. The last two interim CEOs were appointed under the leadership of the above referenced prior Chairperson. The most recent CEO transition was the Board’s appointment of Dmitry Kroshka as permanent Chief Executive Officer in May 2026, under the leadership of Mr. Han as Chairperson, ending the interim leadership period. These distinctions matter when assessing the current Board leadership.

The Committee Also Considered Ms. Zhang’s Ties to Mr. Ding

The Special Committee considered Ms. Zhang’s professional and business relationships with Mr. Ding, including their overlapping service on the Moberg Pharma board and a sub-advisory arrangement between Ms. Zhang’s firm, Trunity Partners, and Goldenwise during 2025. These relationships require scrutiny when assessing whether she would as a Board member exercise judgment independently of the investor sponsoring her candidacy. Calling a nominee independent does not make her commercial ties to that investor irrelevant.

Mr. Ding’s record at Moberg Pharma also warrants scrutiny. Between August 13 and October 5, 2026, while remaining a director, he reported sales totaling 988,607 Moberg shares. Phunware ( PHUN ) stockholders should not confuse a demand for Board influence with a commitment to remain invested for the long term. By contrast, no current Phunware ( PHUN ) director has sold Phunware ( PHUN ) shares during his or her Board tenure (other than to cover taxes upon vesting of shares).

Goldenwise Demands Transparency While Its Own Record Raises Serious Questions

Goldenwise has called for greater transparency from the Board option positions, while its own disclosures to the Company leave serious gaps. In 2020 a complaint was filed in federal court naming Mr. Ding and Goldenwise Capital Management, Inc. as defendants, alleging professional negligence and breach of fiduciary duty arising from approximately $1.3 million in alleged investment losses over several days. This complaint is a matter of public record. Yet Mr. Ding submitted a signed director questionnaire to the Board (at a time when he was proposing himself and three (3) others for Board seats) answering “No” to a direct question asking whether, during the prior 10 years, he had been the subject of a legal proceeding involving breach of fiduciary duty, gross negligence, or similar conduct. In the Company’s view, this discrepancy raises questions about the completeness and accuracy of information provided to the Company in connection with the Goldenwise nominations. A demand for transparency by Goldenwise carries little weight without full candor from the person making it.

The disclosure concerns extend beyond the lawsuit. Mr. Ding’s signed questionnaire identified short call and short put options but provided insufficient detail to understand their terms and economic effect. Goldenwise’s July 10 and July 14 public filings did not describe those positions. Phunware ( PHUN ) publicly questioned these gaps on July 16. Four days later, Goldenwise added contract counts, strike prices, and expiration dates to its filing. Shareholders deserve an explanation for why fuller disclosure followed a public challenge from the Company. These positions also matter when assessing Mr. Ding’s claim of complete alignment with shareholders. Goldenwise’s October 20 filing disclosed short call options alongside long shares and short puts. Short calls can limit participation in a share price recovery above the strike price, while short puts can increase exposure to further declines. These arrangements can create different risks and rewards from those of shareholders who simply hold the stock. Before accepting Mr. Ding’s claim of complete alignment, shareholders deserve a full understanding of the financial interests behind his campaign.

Goldenwise May Seek Reimbursement for Its Campaign

Goldenwise estimates its solicitation costs at approximately $130,000 and stated that, if successful, it intends to seek reimbursement from Phunware ( PHUN ), without submitting such reimbursement to a stockholder vote. Its campaign to reduce Company spending therefore comes with a potential bill for its own expenses.

Stockholders Have Significant Reason to be Cautious

The discrepancy in Mr. Ding’s director questionnaire, Ms. Zhang’s commercial ties to Goldenwise, and the absence of a specific operating plan or alternative strategy proposal, give stockholders significant reasons to be cautious and skeptical about entrusting Goldenwise’s nominee with a Board seat. Mr. Ding’s demand for influence should be tested against the accuracy of his own disclosures and the relevant experience and independence of his nominee. Goldenwise has given stockholders more reasons to question its campaign than to trust its nominee with a seat on the Board.

Stockholder Returns and the Case for Continuity

We recognize that Phunware’s recent share-price performance has been disappointing. We believe that as the Company implements the 2.0 Strategy the market will likely improve that performance. The Special Committee expressly considered stockholder returns in its assessment of Mr. Han, alongside the legacy business challenges, leadership transitions, and timing of the new strategy. Phunware ( PHUN ) 2.0 was approved in early 2026 and its broader leadership and advisory team was assembled in May 2026. The Committee nevertheless concluded that Mr. Han’s demonstrated contributions and relevant expertise make his continued service the best choice for Phunware ( PHUN ) stockholders.

We believe the current Board and management team have established a clear vision, strategy, and direction with Phunware ( PHUN ) 2.0 and that Mr. Han’s continued Board service is necessary to provide needed operational continuity, valuable oversight, and support to management as the Company steers Phunware ( PHUN ) forward from its legacy businesses to implement and execute on the 2.0 Strategy. Goldenwise has not demonstrated that replacing him would strengthen this Board or improve the Company’s prospects.

For these reasons, the Special Committee recommends that stockholders vote “FOR” the re-election of Elliot Han on the WHITE proxy card at the 2026 Annual Meeting.

How to Vote

Phunware ( PHUN ) is using a universal proxy card, which lists the Board’s nominee and the Goldenwise nominee. Because only one director will be elected, please vote “FOR” only one nominee. Marking more than one will invalidate your vote on the election of the Class II director.

  • If you have already returned a GOLD card, you can change your vote by submitting a later-dated WHITE proxy card. Only your latest-dated proxy will be counted.
  • Even if you wish to vote for the Goldenwise nominee, the Board recommends that you use the WHITE proxy card to do so.
  • If you hold shares in more than one account, please vote each WHITE proxy card or voting instruction form you receive.

The Board also recommends that you vote “FOR” the ratification of CBIZ CPAs P.C. as the Company’s independent registered public accounting firm for 2026, “FOR” the advisory vote to approve named executive officer compensation, and for “THREE YEARS” on the frequency of future advisory votes on executive compensation.

To attend the virtual 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, stockholders must register in advance at www.cesonlineservices.com/phun26_vm by 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time on December 16, 2026.

The 2.0 Strategy is in its first year. We ask for your support in giving that strategy the continuity it needs by voting “FOR” Elliot Han on the WHITE proxy card today.

Thank you for your continued support and investment in Phunware ( PHUN ).

Sincerely,

The Special Committee on Election Matters of the Phunware Board of Directors
